name: Banh khot
summary: Bánh khọt is the small crisp cake Vietnam Tourism says a Vung Tau trip is incomplete without. Eat one at a time, herbs around it, fish sauce on the side. It is not a folded bánh xèo.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Tourism sends you to Nguyễn Trường Tộ.
culture: Vietnam Tourism calls it the street snack a Vung Tau trip is incomplete without. The streets named for it are Nguyễn Trường Tộ and Hoàng Hoa Thám. A shop on those streets is a location clue, not a pick.
texture: Vietnam Tourism’s local-eating article says rice-flour batter fried in small cast-iron molds until crisp, topped with shrimp, scallions, and scallion oil. The essential guide says a mini pancake of flour and curry powder, topped with squid or shrimp, green onion, and shrimp powder. The batter accounts disagree. Both stay. The cake is small enough to wrap with herbs. Vietnam Airlines calls the outside crisp and the inside soft, and describes a rich rice-flour batter with shrimp or squid.
taste: Vietnam Tourism’s local-eating article dips it in sweet-sour fish sauce. The essential guide dips it in fish sauce with papaya and chili. Vietnam Airlines dips it in sweet-sour fish sauce with mild chili. The sauce is on the side, not poured over the stack.
howToEat: Eat one cake at a time. Wrap it with lettuce and herbs. Dip, do not drown it.

The batter accounts disagree. Vietnam Tourism’s essential guide uses flour and curry powder. The local-eating article uses rice flour. Vietnam Airlines also says rice flour. Order the cake in front of you. Do not send it back because it lacks curry, or because it has some.
Vietnam Airlines prints 40,000–70,000 VND. Vietnam Tourism printed no stall price.
where: Nguyễn Trường Tộ, on the Back Beach side of town. One kitchen at number 14 prints 7:00–14:00 on weekdays and 7:00–20:00 on Sundays. That kitchen is not a pick.
Hoàng Hoa Thám also has bánh khọt. The street is the one that leads to the whale hall. A shop name is not published here.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 40,000–70,000 VND. Vietnam Tourism printed no stall price.
seoTitle: Banh khot in Vung Tau — the small crisp cake
seoDescription: Bánh khọt is a small molded cake with shrimp, herbs, and fish sauce on the side. Eat it on Nguyễn Trường Tộ. It is not a folded bánh xèo. Vietnam Airlines prints 40,000–70,000 VND.
